title: Add Google Veo video generation nodes
description:
Add support for Google Veo video generation API.

## Veo Models
- Veo 2 - Current stable
- Veo 3.1 - Latest (paid preview)

## Nodes to Create
1. **VeoTextToVideo** - Generate video from text prompt
2. **VeoImageToVideo** - Generate video from image + prompt
3. **VeoExtendVideo** - Extend existing video

## API Details
- Available via Vertex AI (not google-genai SDK)
- Requires different authentication (service account)
- Videos stored temporarily, deleted after 2 days

## Safety Settings (Different from Gemini)
- `personGeneration` parameter (default: "allow_adult")
- Built-in Gemini safety filters run automatically
- SynthID watermarking applied automatically
- HARM_CATEGORY_* settings do NOT apply to Veo

## References
- API Reference: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/model-reference/veo-video-generation
- Responsible AI: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/video/responsible-ai-and-usage-guidelines
- Overview: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/video/overview

## Notes
- May require Google account approval for person/child generation
- Consider if this belongs in gemini/ or separate veo/ package

title: Make Gemini image nodes use GeminiAPIConfig client
Gemini image nodes should inherit safety settings from client
description:
GeminiImageGeneration and GeminiImageEdit create fresh GeminiClient internally using only the API key from the passed client. This means safety settings configured via GeminiSafetySettings node are ignored.

## Current Behavior
```python
# In GeminiImageGeneration.generate_image():
if client is not None:
    image_client = GeminiClient(
        api_key=client.api_key,  # Only copies API key
        model=model
    )
```

## Expected Behavior
Safety settings should be inherited from the passed client:
```python
if client is not None:
    image_client = GeminiClient(
        api_key=client.api_key,
        model=model
    )
    # Copy safety settings
    if client.safety_settings:
        image_client.safety_settings = client.safety_settings
```

## Affected Nodes
- GeminiImageGeneration
- GeminiImageEdit

## Fix
Copy safety_settings (and possibly system_instruction) from passed client to new image_client.

title: Migrate custom nodes from V1 to V3 ComfyUI API
description:
# V1 to V3 ComfyUI Node API Migration

## Context

ComfyUI has introduced a V3 node schema (`comfy_api.latest`) that replaces the legacy V1 pattern (NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS, INPUT_TYPES dicts, etc). The V3 API brings typed inputs/outputs, async execute, lifecycle hooks, node replacement, and other features. However, `v0_0_2` is explicitly unstable — changes will be made without warning. Migration should begin once the API stabilizes (signal: `v0_0_3` created, `v0_0_2` frozen).

Future ComfyUI features will only be added to V3.

## Scope

**51 node classes across 7 providers:**
- Claude: 10 nodes (8 files)
- Gemini: 10 nodes (2 files)
- OpenAI: 7 nodes (2 files)
- WaveSpeed: 13 nodes (11 files, many follow identical template)
- BGRemoval: 5 nodes (3 files)
- Apple/SHARP: 3 nodes (1 file)
- Utils: 1 node (1 file)

Plus: root __init__.py, settings.py, web/erpk_settings.js

## Detailed Migration Plan

### Phase 0: Pre-Migration Research (BLOCKING — do first)
1. **V1/V3 coexistence test** — Can NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS and comfy_entrypoint() coexist in the same package? Create a minimal test node with both patterns, deploy to ComfyUI Desktop, verify both V1 and V3 nodes appear. This determines whether we can migrate incrementally or must do big-bang.
2. **WEB_DIRECTORY in V3** — V3 docs don't mention frontend extension loading. Test whether WEB_DIRECTORY still works with V3 entrypoint. If not, find the V3 equivalent.
3. **Custom aiohttp routes in V3** — Our /erpk/* endpoints (register_user, shared_workflows) use PromptServer.instance.routes directly. Test whether these still work alongside V3, or if they need to move into ComfyExtension.on_load().
4. **API stability check** — Monitor comfy_api version. Don't proceed past Phase 0 until v0_0_2 is frozen or we accept the risk.

### Phase 1: Infrastructure (after Phase 0 answers are clear)
1. **Define V3 custom types** — Create shared type definitions using io.Custom() or @io.comfytype for our 4 client types + 3 session types:
   - CLAUDE_API_CLIENT, OPENAI_API_CLIENT, GEMINI_API_CLIENT, WAVESPEED_AI_API_CLIENT
   - CLAUDE_CONVERSATION, OPENAI_CHAT_SESSION, GEMINI_CHAT_SESSION
2. **Create ComfyExtension subclass** — Single ERPKExtension class with on_load() (for node replacements + route registration) and get_node_list() (aggregates all providers).
3. **Create comfy_entrypoint()** — In root __init__.py or dedicated file.

### Phase 2: Migrate Claude (10 nodes — pilot)
Smallest provider, good test case. Convert each node file:
1. claude/nodes.py — ClaudeAPIClient, ClaudeUsageStats (2 nodes, both OUTPUT_NODE)
2. claude/text_generation.py — ClaudeTextGeneration (IS_CHANGED)
3. claude/vision_analysis.py — ClaudeVisionAnalysis (IS_CHANGED)
4. claude/conversation.py — ClaudeConversation, ClaudeConversationInfo (OUTPUT_NODE)
5. claude/prompt_enhancer.py — ClaudePromptEnhancer (IS_CHANGED)
6. claude/token_counter.py — ClaudeTokenCounter (OUTPUT_NODE)
7. claude/tool_definition.py — ClaudeToolDefinition
8. claude/structured_output.py — ClaudeStructuredOutput (IS_CHANGED)

**Per-node conversion checklist:**
- [ ] Add io.ComfyNode base class
- [ ] Convert INPUT_TYPES dict -> define_schema() with io.Schema
- [ ] Convert each input: STRING -> io.String.Input(), INT -> io.Int.Input(), combo lists -> io.Combo.Input(), custom types -> io.Custom("TYPE").Input()
- [ ] Convert RETURN_TYPES/RETURN_NAMES -> outputs list in schema
- [ ] Move CATEGORY, OUTPUT_NODE into schema
- [ ] Rename FUNCTION method to execute, change self to cls, add @classmethod
- [ ] Change return (result,) to return io.NodeOutput(result)
- [ ] Rename IS_CHANGED to fingerprint_inputs where used
- [ ] Add to ERPKExtension.get_node_list()
- [ ] Register V1->V3 node replacement (same node_id, no input mapping needed if IDs unchanged)
- [ ] Run existing tests, fix breakage

**Async opportunity:** ClaudeTextGeneration, ClaudeVisionAnalysis, ClaudeConversation, ClaudeStructuredOutput all make HTTP API calls — convert execute to async.

### Phase 3: Migrate Gemini (10 nodes)
Same per-node checklist. Two files:
- gemini/nodes.py — 8 nodes (GeminiAPIConfig, TextGeneration, Chat, Vision, SystemInstruction, SafetySettings, ImageGeneration, ImageEdit)
- gemini/veo_nodes.py — 2 nodes (VeoTextToVideo, VeoImageToVideo)
IS_CHANGED used in: TextGeneration, Chat, Vision, ImageGeneration, ImageEdit, Veo nodes

### Phase 4: Migrate OpenAI (7 nodes)
- openai/nodes.py — 5 nodes (APIConfig, TextGeneration, Chat, Vision, SystemInstruction)
- openai/image_nodes.py — 2 nodes (ImageGeneration, ImageEdit)
IS_CHANGED used in: TextGeneration, Chat, Vision, ImageGeneration, ImageEdit

### Phase 5: Migrate WaveSpeed (13 nodes)
Most nodes follow an identical template (model-specific wrappers). Strategy:
- wavespeed/nodes.py — 4 nodes (APIClient, PreviewVideo, SaveAudio, UploadFile). PreviewVideo + SaveAudio are OUTPUT_NODE.
- 9 model files — all follow same pattern with FUNCTION = "execute", IS_CHANGED. Consider creating a V3 base class that all model nodes inherit from to avoid duplicating define_schema boilerplate.

### Phase 6: Migrate BGRemoval (5 nodes)
- bgremoval/rembg_node.py — 1 node
- bgremoval/inspyrenet_node.py — 1 node
- bgremoval/birefnet_node.py — 3 nodes

### Phase 7: Migrate Apple + Utils (4 nodes)
- apple/sharp_nodes.py — 3 nodes
- utils/concat_strings.py — 1 node

### Phase 8: Cleanup
1. Remove all NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS / NODE_DISPLAY_NAME_MAPPINGS dicts
2. Remove old __init__.py aggregation pattern
3. Verify WEB_DIRECTORY / frontend extensions still work
4. Verify custom routes still work
5. Register node replacements for any nodes where IDs changed
6. Update README with V3 migration notes
7. Full test suite pass

## Key Risks
- **API instability**: v0_0_2 is explicitly unstable. Breaking changes could hit us mid-migration.
- **Frontend extension gap**: No V3 guidance on WEB_DIRECTORY or frontend JS.
- **Coexistence unknown**: If V1+V3 can't coexist in one package, we must do big-bang (all 51 nodes at once).
- **Instance state**: V3 sanitizes node classes before execution. If any node accidentally relies on instance state, it breaks silently.

## What We Gain
- async execute for all API-calling nodes (better ComfyUI responsiveness)
- Node replacement API (safe renames/refactors)
- is_deprecated / is_experimental flags
- Progress reporting via ComfyAPI
- DynamicCombo for mode-dependent inputs
- not_idempotent flag (cleaner than IS_CHANGED returning NaN)
- search_aliases for discoverability
- Access to all future V3-only features

Add missing BiRefNet model variants from ZhengPeng7:
- General-Lite (BiRefNet_T) - lighter, faster
- General-Lite-2K - high res lite variant
- General-dynamic - dynamic resolution support
- General-reso_512 - optimized for 512x512
- General-legacy - trained on different datasets
- Matting-Lite - lightweight matting variant
- DIS (BiRefNet-DIS5K) - dichotomous image segmentation
- HRSOD (BiRefNet-HRSOD) - high-res salient object detection
- Portrait (BiRefNet-portrait) - human portraits

Reference: https://github.com/lldacing/ComfyUI_BiRefNet_ll

title: BiRefNet: Add dtype selection (float16/float32)

Add dtype parameter to BiRefNet node for VRAM efficiency.

float16 uses ~50% less VRAM while maintaining quality for most use cases.
Currently only supports float32.

Reference: https://github.com/lldacing/ComfyUI_BiRefNet_ll

title: BiRefNet: Add foreground refinement (BlurFusion)
description:
Add BlurFusionForegroundEstimation as a separate node or option.

Uses fast-foreground-estimation method to produce cleaner foregrounds by estimating true foreground colors at semi-transparent edges. Reduces color bleeding from background.

Reference: 
- https://github.com/lldacing/ComfyUI_BiRefNet_ll
- https://github.com/Photoroom/fast-foreground-estimation
